intro:
For forty years, the Eastside Library has been the only free place in our neighbourhood to study, get online, or just get warm. Next spring, the council wants to turn it into parking.

Maria, a nurse who did her coursework here at night, put it simply: "Without this building, I wouldn't have my job." There are thousands of stories like hers.

We're a volunteer group of neighbours, parents and librarians. We've filed a legal challenge and we're taking our case to every council member. We can win this, but not without you.
